metadata.title: Robot Wiki
metadata.description: Citation-first encyclopedia of modern robot learning.

metadata.title: A-Z Index
metadata.description: Every published Robot Wiki article and glossary term in one alphabetical list.

metadata.title: Adjacent Domains
metadata.description: Autonomous vehicles, drones and surgical and space robotics, each in brief.

metadata.title: Autonomous Vehicles
metadata.description: The AV stack as a robotics problem: perception, prediction, planning, and the long tail.

metadata.title: Drones and Aerial Robotics
metadata.description: Autonomous flight, aggressive maneuvers, and swarm coordination.

metadata.title: Space Robotics
metadata.description: NASA/JPL systems, orbital servicing, and ISRU: robotics where repair is impossible.

metadata.title: Surgical Robotics
metadata.description: Intuitive, CMR, and Moon Surgical: the precision and reliability bar for certified robots.

metadata.title: Classical Foundations
metadata.description: The kinematics, planning, control and estimation stack that sits under every learned policy.

metadata.title: Control
metadata.description: PID, LQR, MPC, and whole-body QP: the classical stack under every learned policy.

metadata.title: Grasp Planning
metadata.description: Contact mechanics, grasp quality metrics, and force closure.

metadata.title: Kinematics
metadata.description: Forward and inverse kinematics, DH parameters, and the Jacobian; the theory behind the 3D playground.

metadata.title: Motion Planning
metadata.description: RRT and its optimal variants, trajectory optimization, and CHOMP/TrajOpt.

metadata.title: Perception for Manipulation
metadata.description: Calibration through 6-DoF pose: the pipeline that finds the object, and its error budget.

metadata.title: Scene Representation and Mapping
metadata.description: What a robot remembers about the space around it, and why the map that renders best is not the map a planner can use.

metadata.title: State Estimation
metadata.description: Kalman filters, factor graphs, and pose estimation from noisy sensors.

metadata.title: Credits
metadata.description: Every photograph and diagram on Robot Wiki, with its creator, source, and licence.

metadata.title: Data, Hardware & Evaluation
metadata.description: The embodied data bottleneck and the machines themselves, with the measurement crisis behind every benchmark claim.

metadata.title: The Data Bottleneck
metadata.description: Robot-hours versus LLM tokens: the log-log reality of embodied data and teleop-farm economics.

metadata.title: Major Datasets
metadata.description: Open X-Embodiment, DROID, BridgeData V2, AgiBot World, RoboMIND: five datasets compared.

metadata.title: The Evaluation Crisis
metadata.description: Why N-of-10 trials and unreported variance mislead: 95% per-step success is unusable at 30 steps.

metadata.title: Hardware Taxonomy
metadata.description: Arms, humanoids, hands, sensors, and compute: a buyer's guide from SO-101 to Jetson Thor.

metadata.title: Industrial Deployment
metadata.description: The installed base robot learning is trying to enter, and the jam-rate arithmetic that decides whether a 99 percent cell ships.

metadata.title: Teleoperation Rigs
metadata.description: ALOHA, GELLO, UMI, and VR teleop: cost, data quality, throughput, and the embodiment gap.

metadata.title: Frontier & Open Problems
metadata.description: The reliability gap that keeps demos out of production, and the competing theses about closing it.

metadata.title: The Bear Case
metadata.description: Why this could be another robotics winter, and the milestones that would prove it wrong.

metadata.title: Competing Theses
metadata.description: End-to-end scaling versus hierarchy versus world models versus RL fine-tuning, with falsification criteria.

metadata.title: Dexterity
metadata.description: Contact-rich manipulation, the tactile sensing gap, in-hand reorientation, and deformables.

metadata.title: Generalization
metadata.description: What the pi0.5 and pi0.7 results demonstrate, and what they do not: the open-world gap.

metadata.title: The Reliability Gap
metadata.description: 80% is a demo, 99.9% is a product: what deployment numbers actually show.

metadata.title: Safety and Assurance
metadata.description: Industrial robotics can certify a control system but not a learned policy, so what ships is a verifiable safety layer wrapped around an unverifiable one.

metadata.title: Glossary
metadata.description: Cited definitions of the robotics and machine-learning terms used across Robot Wiki.

metadata.title: Manipulation & Learned Policies
metadata.description: From behavior cloning to vision-language-action models: how modern robots learn to act.

metadata.title: Action Chunking (ACT and ALOHA)
metadata.description: Predicting action sequences instead of single steps: the CVAE structure, the chunk-size tradeoff, and temporal ensembling.

metadata.title: Behavior Cloning Foundations
metadata.description: Covariate shift and compounding error: why naive imitation breaks in closed loop, with DAgger as the standard fix.

metadata.title: Comparison Matrix
metadata.description: Every major policy across eight architectural axes: action representation, horizon, frequency, backbone, conditioning, cross-embodiment, hierarchy, openness.

metadata.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer
metadata.description: Padded action vectors, motion transfer, and shared relative end-effector frames; the live disagreement.

metadata.title: Diffusion Policy
metadata.description: Visuomotor control as conditional denoising over action sequences, with receding-horizon execution.

metadata.title: Other Generalist Policies
metadata.description: Gemini Robotics, GR00T, Helix, Skild, and GO-2: how to read closed-model vendor claims.

metadata.title: Hierarchical Approaches
metadata.description: SayCan, code-as-policies, and keypoint affordances; why separate planners gave way to internalized hierarchy.

metadata.title: Knowledge Insulation
metadata.description: Training the VLM backbone on discrete tokens while a flow-matching expert learns actions behind a stop-gradient.

metadata.title: The Pi Line
metadata.description: pi0 to pi0.7: flow-matching action experts, FAST tokenization, open-world generalization, and where open weights stop.

metadata.title: Real-Time Execution
metadata.description: Temporal ensembling and real-time chunking: the latency budgets that decide whether the control loop closes.

metadata.title: RL Fine-Tuning of Policies
metadata.description: DPPO, ConRFT, Recap, pi_RL, residual RL, and HIL-SERL: closing the reliability gap with on-policy experience.

metadata.title: Vision-Language-Action Models
metadata.description: RT-1, RT-2, RT-X, Octo, and OpenVLA: web-scale pretraining meets robot control, and the cost of discrete action tokens.

metadata.title: Market Map
metadata.description: The embodied-AI industry as data: companies across six segments, filterable by approach, geography, stage, and funding.

metadata.title: 3D Kinematics Playground
metadata.description: A SO-101 robot arm rendered from its URDF in the browser: joint sliders for forward kinematics, click-to-reach inverse kinematics, and trajectory record/replay.

metadata.title: RL, Sim-to-Real & Locomotion
metadata.description: Reinforcement learning at scale, from massively parallel simulation to the transfer problem.

metadata.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Control
metadata.description: Motion tracking from PHC to ASAP and GMT, and the three decompositions of 2026.

metadata.title: Legged Locomotion Lineage
metadata.description: From ANYmal to Unitree and the MIT humanoid line: how learned gaits became the default.

metadata.title: Massively Parallel Sim RL
metadata.description: Isaac Lab, Newton, MJX, and Brax: GPU-parallel environments and the wall-clock economics of training.

metadata.title: Reward Design and the MPC Debate
metadata.description: LLM-written rewards and curricula; where classical trajectory optimization still wins.

metadata.title: RL for Robotics
metadata.description: Sample efficiency decides which reinforcement learning algorithms a robot can actually be trained with, from PPO in simulation to offline learning on a fixed dataset.

metadata.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer
metadata.description: Domain randomization, teacher-student distillation, system identification, and real-to-sim correction.

metadata.title: Why RL Won Locomotion but Not Manipulation
metadata.description: The MDP simulability gap: contact-rich manipulation resists the simulation that made walking routine.

metadata.title: Search
metadata.description: Search Robot Wiki: full-text over article prose plus the structured data layer (methods, companies, datasets).

metadata.title: World Models
metadata.description: Learned simulators and action-conditioned video prediction, with the JEPA counterargument.

metadata.title: Generative Simulation
metadata.description: Generated content inside real physics engines beats generated dynamics: RoboGen, Holodeck, RoboCasa.

metadata.title: Generative Video World Models
metadata.description: Cosmos, Genie, and GR-2: action-conditioned video prediction and the conditioning-strength problem.

metadata.title: JEPA and the Non-Generative Counterargument
metadata.description: V-JEPA 2 and LeCun's case that prediction in representation space beats pixel generation.

metadata.title: Latent-Dynamics World Models
metadata.description: Dreamer, TD-MPC2, and DayDreamer: compact learned dynamics for imagination-based control.

metadata.title: What Is a World Model?
metadata.description: Six paradigms share one name: latent dynamics, decoder-free latent, generative video, JEPA, unified world-action, and symbolic.
